title: Dynamic MI instance count with Fun evaluation

changes: Extended mi_policy() type in wf_vm.erl to add {dynamic, fun((map()) -> pos_integer()), pos_integer(), pos_integer()} variant
Added eval_instance_count clause for {dynamic, Fun, Min, Max} pattern
Fun is called with Ctx, wrapped in try/catch (returns Min on any exception)
Result clamped between Min and Max using max(Min, min(Max, Raw))
Preserved backward-compatible {dynamic, Min, Max} clause that returns Min
